upload_concurrency.hint_zh: 供应商发票同时上传的文件数。
upload_concurrency.hint_en: Number of supplier files uploaded at once.

interactive_concurrency.hint_zh: 每个浏览器批次同时提交的识别数。

worker_concurrency.hint_zh: 每个应用实例的后台任务数，仍受总识别并发限制。
worker_concurrency.hint_en: Jobs per application instance, subject to the shared recognition limit.

recognition_concurrency.hint_zh: 两个入口及共用数据库的应用实例共享此额度；降低后等待在途任务结束。
recognition_concurrency.hint_en: Shared by both entry points and application instances using the same database. Lower limits wait for existing jobs.

queue_timeout_seconds.hint_zh: 普通报销超时后提示重试；供应商任务保留在队列。
queue_timeout_seconds.hint_en: Reimbursement requests report a busy service; supplier jobs return to the queue.

total_timeout_seconds.hint_zh: 包括预处理和所有模型尝试，不包括等待识别额度。
total_timeout_seconds.hint_en: Includes preprocessing and all model attempts; excludes the shared queue wait.

model_timeout_seconds.hint_en: Must not exceed the processing budget.

max_extra_attempts.hint_zh: 异常重试与补金额共用此次数；0 表示只调用一次。
max_extra_attempts.hint_en: Retries and amount repair share this allowance. Zero means a single attempt.

amount_repair_enabled.hint_zh: 先尝试已有金额关系；仍缺金额且有预算时才补识别。
amount_repair_enabled.hint_en: Repair runs only when existing amounts are insufficient and budget remains.

max_pdf_pages.zh: 单份 PDF 最大页数
max_pdf_pages.hint_zh: 超过时明确提示拆分文件，避免漏掉后续明细。
max_pdf_pages.hint_en: Larger documents are rejected with a split-file message; pages are never silently omitted.

image_max_edge.hint_zh: 控制渲染与上传体积；降低前应验证小字和明细的准确率。
image_max_edge.hint_en: Bounds rendering and upload size. Verify small text and line accuracy before reducing.

jpeg_quality.hint_zh: 质量越高，请求体积通常越大。
jpeg_quality.hint_en: Higher quality generally increases request size.
